latHint: Think seeds falling on rocky ground and a path.
pivHint: REAP isn't just what you gain when you sow righteousness, Hosea says. In one of Jesus' most famous parables, the person who scatters seed is called the ______.
winText: You found it. REAP isn't just what you gain from sowing righteousness — pair it with SOWER, and you've got Jesus' famous Parable of the SOWER.
lossText: The word was SOWER. REAP was the pivot — in Jesus' famous parable, the person who scatters seed on different types of soil is called the SOWER.
votdVerse: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord, until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.
passageText: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord, until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.
